messages:
alex.j: FYI seeing a spike of KMS decrypt failures for an onprem private deployment (customer=acme). started ~17:58 UTC, ~120 errors/min
maria.k: can you paste a short log snippet? :eyes:
alex.j: sure, here's the tail from the keystore proxy
```
2026-03-22T17:58:12Z ERROR keystore-proxy decrypt namespace=acme err="rpc error: code=Unavailable desc="connection reset by peer""
2026-03-22T17:58:15Z WARN  keystore-proxy token=svcacc:redwood-priv-agent status=403
2026-03-22T17:58:18Z ERROR kms:hsm-connector timeout backend=onprem-hsm
```
maria.k: hmm 403s + Unavailable. is this the customer HSM behind the bastion or are we hitting our keystore proxy limits?
tanya: infra note: we had a NAT maintenance at 17:45 UTC, conntrack counters were high on the edge NAT for that tenant yesterday
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1724 - assigned to oncall
sean: quick checklist: 1) confirm if HSM reachable from bastion; 2) scan RBAC audit for 403 patterns; 3) consider temporary netpol relax for proxy->hsm
alex.j: RBAC audit shows most calls are 200 but ~30 unique 403s from svcacc:redwood-priv-agent between 17:57-18:00
maria.k: do we have token expiry or clock skew causing auth failures?
alex.j: svcacc token TTL looked fine; no clock skew in hosts. The 403s correlate to connection resets in the proxy logs
sean: could be transient TLS handshake failures from overloaded connection pools. can we dump proxy pool metrics?
tanya: i'll grab conntrack and iptables counts from the bastion and edge host now
ops-bot: oncall pinged @tanya at 17:59:45Z
alex.j: proposed triage: a) rotate svcacc token to rule out token compromise, b) enable tcp keepalive and bump conntrack timeout temporarily, c) increase keystore proxy verbosity for 10m and keep logs off-host for forensics
maria.k: agree. also capture a pcap of the proxy->hsm traffic (with consent) for chain-of-custody — retention 30d
devsec: +1 on pcap + keep full audit.log for the window. we need evidence for SLA/customer compliance. file an internal post-incident runbook item to improve KMS fallback wiring
sean: i'll prepare a fallback route to cloud-KMS variant that can be flipped in 1 minute if onprem remains flaky (need ops approval)
tanya: rotating svcacc now, pushing netpol change to allow longer-lived proxy connections to HSM
ops-bot: Update: svcacc rotation completed by tanya at 18:03:12Z
alex.j: after rotation and conntrack bump errors dropped to ~2/min, still monitoring :mag:
maria.k: good signal. conservatively keep elevated logging for 30m then revert
devsec: filing follow-up doc to eng-security wiki: hardening checklist for onprem keystore, RBAC audit retention, network fallback playbook
alex.j: thanks everyone — will keep thread updated and close once stable :thumbsup:
